hook: GHMC clears footpaths in Tolichowki, Shaikpet: drives *every week* now
hook_b: GHMC clears footpaths in Tolichowki, Shaikpet: drives *every week* now
tldr: GHMC's Town Planning wing ran a drive against footpath encroachments on Thursday and says such drives will happen every week.

beats.what: The drive targeted footpath encroachments in Shaikpet, Tolichowki and Golconda on Nov 26.
beats.why: GHMC says it wants safe walking space for pedestrians and less traffic congestion.
beats.care: Shop owners with sheds or hoardings on footpaths could be next; walkers may get space back.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: ACP Swamy Naik of GHMC's Town Planning wing said the drives will be weekly. Tolichowki and Golconda police and Tolichowki traffic police were present.

cards.q: Weekly footpath clearing drives: fair call?

qs: Will cleared footpaths stay clear between weekly drives?

facts.t: Police from *3* units, Tolichowki, Golconda and Tolichowki traffic, joined the drive.

steps.e: Footpaths cleared in Shaikpet, Tolichowki, Golconda
Owners told to remove sheds, hoardings themselves

viz.verdict: Walkers gain space; shops on footpaths face removal.

watch: Which neighbourhoods GHMC targets in next week's drive.

sources.title: GHMC removes footpath encroachments from Shaikpet, Tolichowki

fact: GHMC cleared footpath encroachments in Shaikpet, Tolichowki and Golconda, *weekly* drives next
twist: GHMC asked owners to remove sheds and hoardings themselves, warning its removal *might damage* property.
